title: Border and Safehouse
author: Coral Brightwater
blurb: Ines Lockridge, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
